response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), base AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS b FROM signals), kept AS (SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_mod, base.b FROM g CROSS JOIN base WHERE g.avg_mod > base.b) SELECT rfistat, avg_mod AS avg_modindex, avg_mod - b AS above_baseline, avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM kept) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept
